IRS990.Desc: TOWN SCHOOL FOR BOYS IS AN INDEPENDENT ALL BOYS' SCHOOL SERVING GRADES K-8 WITH AN APPROXIMATE ENROLLMENT OF 415. AT TOWN SCHOOL, LEARNING IS PRIZED, LOVE OF SCHOOL IS ESSENTIAL, AND BOYHOOD IS CELEBRATED. AS AN ALL BOYS' SCHOOL, TOWN PROVIDES A RICH, CHALLENGING AND RIGOROUS EDUCATIONAL EXPERIENCE THAT ADDRESSES THE DISTINCTIVE ENERGY LEVELS AND DEVELOPMENTAL STYLES OF BOYS. TOWN VALUES BEING A DIVERSE AND INCLUSIVE COMMUNITY THAT NURTURES INTEGRITY, SENSITIVITY AND RESPECT IN ITS BOYS, AND PREPARES THEM TO BECOME PRODUCTIVE AND CONTRIBUTING MEMBERS OF AN EVER-CHANGING WORLD. IN ADDITION TO ITS ACADEMIC PROGRAM, TOWN ALSO OFFERS OTHER ACTIVITIES INCLUDING ATHLETICS, EXTENDED DAY PROGRAMS, OUTDOOR EDUCATION EXPERIENCES, CLUBS AND AFFINITY GROUPS, SERVICE LEARNING AND GLOBAL CITIZENSHIP OPPORTUNITIES THAT ALL SHAPE TOWN'S PORTRAIT OF A GRADUATE AND CELEBRATE TOWN'S VALUES OF RESPECT, CURIOSITY, BELONGING, INTEGRITY, AND JOY.

Form990PartVIISectionAGrp.TitleTxt: DIR. OF TEACHER DEV. & STRAT. INIT.

SupplementalInformationDetail.ExplanationTxt: THE SCHOOL'S ENDOWMENT FUNDS (THE "FUND") CONSIST OF RESTRICTED FUNDS TO BE HELD IN PERPETUITY AS WELL AS ASSOCIATED UNAPPROPRIATED INVESTMENT EARNINGS AND ARE CLASSIFIED AS NET ASSETS WITH DONOR RESTRICTIONS. THE FUND DOES NOT HAVE ANY BOARD DESIGNATED ENDOWMENT FUNDS.

THE SCHOOL IS EXEMPT FROM FEDERAL AND STATE INCOME TAXES UNDER THE INTERNAL REVENUE CODE SECTION 501(C)(3) AND BY THE CALIFORNIA REVENUE AND TAXATION CODE 23701D. ACCORDINGLY, THE SCHOOL HAS NOT PROVIDED FOR INCOME TAXES IN THESE CONSOLIDATED FINANCIAL STATEMENTS. TOWN SCHOOL PROPERTIES, LLC IS A PASS-THROUGH ENTITY FOR INCOME TAX REPORTING PURPOSES AND, ACCORDINGLY, DOES NOT PAY TAX ON ITS INCOME. INSTEAD, INCOME OR LOSS IS REPORTED ON THE TAX RETURNS OF THE SCHOOL. THE ENTITY IS SUBJECT TO A MINIMUM FRANCHISE TAX FOR THE STATE OF CALIFORNIA. EACH YEAR, MANAGEMENT CONSIDERS WHETHER ANY MATERIAL TAX POSITION THE ORGANIZATION HAS TAKEN IS MORE LIKELY THAN NOT TO BE SUSTAINED UPON EXAMINATION BY THE APPLICABLE TAXING AUTHORITY. MANAGEMENT BELIEVES THAT ANY POSITIONS THE ORGANIZATION HAS TAKEN ARE SUPPORTED BY SUBSTANTIAL AUTHORITY, AND HENCE, DO NOT NEED TO BE MEASURED OR DISCLOSED IN THESE CONSOLIDATED FINANCIAL STATEMENTS.

WE ARE NOW ALLOWED TO PUBLISH OUR RACIALLY NONDISCRIMINATORY POLICY ON OUR PRIMARY PUBLICLY ACCESSIBLE INTERNET HOMEPAGE AT ALL TIMES DURING ITS TAXABLE YEAR IN A MANNER REASONABLY EXPECTED TO BE NOTICED BY VISITORS TO THE HOMEPAGE. THE NOTICE CANNOT BE BEHIND A PASSWORD OR PAYWALL, AND IT MUST BE ON THE PRIMARY LANDING PAGE.

TO QUALIFY FOR TUITION ASSISTANCE, FAMILIES NEED TO COMPLETE THE PARENTS' FINANCIAL STATEMENT (PFS) FORM AND SUBMIT IT TO STUDENT SERVICE FOR FINANCIAL AID (SSS), AN INDEPENDENT NATIONAL AGENCY THAT EVALUATES A FAMILY'S ABILITY TO AFFORD INDEPENDENT SCHOOL EDUCATION. EACH FAMILY RECEIVES A REPORT FROM SSS THAT SHOWS WHAT THE FAMILY CAN CONTRIBUTE FOR ALL STUDENTS IN TUITION CHARGING SCHOOLS. THE SCHOOL'S TUITION ASSISTANCE COMMITTEE (COMPRISED OF THE HEAD OF SCHOOL; CFO; THE DIRECTOR OF ADMISSION AND TUITION ASSISTANCE; AND THE DIRECTOR OF COMMUNITY BUILDING AND INCLUSION), WILL REVIEW THE SSS EVALUATION AND EACH FAMILY'S APPLICATION TO DETERMINE IF AND AT WHAT LEVEL TUITION ASSISTANCE IS APPROPRIATE.

RltdOrgOfficerTrstKeyEmplGrp.TitleTxt: DIR. OF TEACHER DEV. & STRAT. INIT.

SupplementalInformationDetail.ExplanationTxt: AS PART OF THE CURRENT HEAD OF SCHOOL CONTRACT, HOUSING AND TAXES ON THIS BENEFIT ARE PROVIDED AND ARE REPORTED AS TAXABLE COMPENSATION TO THE HEAD OF SCHOOL.

SupplementalInformationDetail.FormAndLineReferenceDesc: FORM 990, PART VI, SECTION B, LINE 11B
SupplementalInformationDetail.ExplanationTxt: BY RESOLUTION OF THE BOARD OF DIRECTORS, THE AUDIT COMMITTEE OF THE BOARD REVIEWS THE TAX RETURN WITH THE AUDITOR ON BEHALF OF THE BOARD. THE CHAIR OF THE AUDIT COMMITTEE MAKES A COPY OF THE 990 (WITH REDACTED SCHEDULE B) AVAILABLE TO THE ENTIRE BOARD AND RESPONDS TO QUESTIONS FROM THE BOARD REGARDING THE 990.

SupplementalInformationDetail.FormAndLineReferenceDesc: FORM 990, PART VI, SECTION B, LINE 12C
SupplementalInformationDetail.ExplanationTxt: ON AN ANNUAL BASIS, ALL TRUSTEES ARE PROVIDED A COPY OF THE CONFLICT OF INTEREST DISCLOSURE STATEMENT. THIS DISCLOSURE STATEMENT MUST BE COMPLETED AND RETURNED TO THE CHAIR OF THE COMMITTEE OF TRUSTEES BY OCTOBER 1 OF EACH YEAR FOR REVIEW BY THE EXECUTIVE COMMITTEE. SHOULD A MEMBER OF THE EXECUTIVE COMMITTEE BE THE SUBJECT OF A POSSIBLE CONFLICT OF INTEREST, THAT MEMBER WILL EXCUSE HIMSELF/HERSELF FROM THE ROOM DURING COMMITTEE DISCUSSION AND ANY VOTING REGARDING THAT CONFLICT. ALL NEW TRUSTEES MUST COMPLETE THE DISCLOSURE STATEMENT PRIOR TO ASSUMING THEIR DUTIES FOR THE SCHOOL. THE EXECUTIVE COMMITTEE SUBMITS AN ANNUAL CONFIDENTIAL REPORT TO THE BOARD OF TRUSTEES REGARDING ANY TRUSTEE CONFLICTS OF INTEREST AND THEIR RESOLUTION.

SupplementalInformationDetail.FormAndLineReferenceDesc: FORM 990, PART VI, SECTION B, LINE 15
SupplementalInformationDetail.ExplanationTxt: THE PROCESS FOR DETERMINING THE APPROPRIATE COMPENSATION FOR THE HEAD OF SCHOOL BEGINS WITH A REQUEST FROM THE COMPENSATION COMMITTEE OF THE BOARD FOR A CUSTOM BENCHMARK STUDY FROM THE NATIONAL ASSOCIATION OF INDEPENDENT SCHOOLS (NAIS) FOR COMPENSATION DATA FROM MEMBER SCHOOLS OF NAIS AND THE CALIFORNIA ASSOCIATION OF INDEPENDENT SCHOOLS (CAIS). IN ADDITION, THE CUSTOM STUDY INCLUDES A GROUP OF UP TO 15 LEADING INDEPENDENT SCHOOLS LOCATED IN HIGH COST-OF-LIVING COMMUNITIES. THE COMPENSATION COMMITTEE ANALYZES THIS DATA TO DETERMINE THE APPROPRIATE COMPENSATION PACKAGE FOR THE HEAD OF SCHOOL. FOR THE COMPENSATION FOR OTHER KEY EMPLOYEES, THE HEAD OF SCHOOL REVIEWS DATA ANNUALLY FROM THE STATISTICS PRODUCED BY BOTH CAIS AND THE INDEPENDENT SCHOOLS BUSINESS OFFICERS ASSOCIATION (CAL-ISBOA) FOR COMPENSATION DATA FOR SIMILARLY QUALIFIED PERSONS.

SupplementalInformationDetail.FormAndLineReferenceDesc: FORM 990, PART VI, SECTION C, LINE 19
SupplementalInformationDetail.ExplanationTxt: THE ORGANIZATION MAKES ITS GOVERNING DOCUMENTS, CONFLICT OF INTEREST POLICY, AND FINANCIAL STATEMENTS AVAILABLE TO THE PUBLIC UPON REQUEST.

SupplementalInformationDetail.FormAndLineReferenceDesc: FORM 990, PART VII, SECTION A - COLUMN (D):
SupplementalInformationDetail.ExplanationTxt: INCLUDES CONTRACT PAY PLUS ANY COMPENSATION FOR ADDITIONAL ROLES OUTSIDE OF THE EMPLOYEES CONTRACT SUCH AS COACHING, CAMPS, SERVING ON A COMMITTEE, ETC.
THE ORGANIZATION DID NOT CHANGE ITS OVERSIGHT PROCESS OR SELECTION PROCESS DURING THE TAX YEAR.
